E2711

Derive orphan rule: neither `` `derive T.{trait_name}` `` nor `` `{type}` `` is local.

What

Derive orphan rule: neither `` `derive T.{trait_name}` `` nor `` `{type}` `` is local.

Why

A generated implementation has a clear local owner only when its derive provider or target type lives in the entry module. Two imported sides leave the entry package owning neither contract.

Fix

Define `derive T.{trait_name}` or `{type}` in the entry module.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E2711: tests/ui/E2711_derive_orphan/stderr.

Error [jet.OrphanDerive]: Derive orphan rule: neither `derive T.Named` nor `Bar` is local
 Why: A generated implementation is owned locally only when the derive provider or target type lives in the entry module
 Fix: Define `derive T.Named` or `Bar` in the entry module
